data_points.source_name: Samjong KPMG via The Korea Herald
data_points.notes: KR dermocosmetics market KRW 4.5tn in 2020, up 17.6% vs five years prior (Samjong KPMG). Article's own USD conversion ~US$3.1bn. Value basis not stated by source; assumed consumer sell-through. cf Korea Cosmeceutical Education & Research Institute KRW 1.2tn for same year 2020 (narrower definition) and KERI KRW 4.5tn for 2022 — Korean sources conflict on definition. Article dated 2022-06-23.

data_points.source_name: Korea Cosmeceutical Education & Research Institute via Maeil Ilbo
data_points.notes: KR derma cosmetics market grew from KRW 500bn (2017) to KRW 1.2tn (2020) per Korea Cosmeceutical Education & Research Institute. Conflicts with Samjong KPMG KRW 4.5tn for 2020 (cf) — 3.75x gap is definitional (this appears to be a narrow pharmacy/cosmeceutical definition). Same article: global derma market US$62.52bn 2022 -> US$94.84bn 2028 (Industry Research). Article dated 2024-01-29.

data_points.source_name: Korean Enterprise Reputation Research Institute via Pharm Edaily
data_points.notes: KR dermocosmetics market KRW 4.5tn in 2022, ~8x growth from KRW 500bn in 2017. cf Samjong KPMG which puts KRW 4.5tn already in 2020 — one of the two vintages is misdated or definitions differ; do not average. Value basis unstated. Article dated 2025-08-13.

data_points.source_name: Korean Enterprise Reputation Research Institute via Pharm Edaily
data_points.notes: PROJECTION: KR dermocosmetics market projected KRW 5.5tn for 2025 (from KRW 4.5tn 2022, implying ~7% CAGR 2022-2025). Consistent direction with Euromonitor +13% growth read for 2024 already on file. Article dated 2025-08-13.
